title: introduce-kms-sidecar-policy-enforcer-and-audit-attenuator
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: customers running Redwood Private requested stronger guardrails to ensure per-tenant KMS selection follows residency/region pins and that audit logs emitted from operator-side components don’t leak PII or long-lived secrets. This PR implements a KMS sidecar policy enforcer (runs as a process adjacent to caller services in Private/Dedicated) that evaluates RBAC v2 bindings against a residency-aware policy matrix and rewrites / rejects KMS requests when a mismatch is detected. It also introduces an audit attenuator middleware that normalizes and redacts high-risk audit fields (keys, raw ciphertext blobs, long auth tokens) while preserving verifiable provenance metadata (request id, tenant id hash, policy decision id). Goals: enforce KMS region affinity at callsite, provide a standardized RBAC v2 claim translation for sidecar use, and reduce sensitive data surface in audit streams for downstream compliance tooling. Changes: - New sidecar component: pkg/kms/sidecar/enforcer.go + config + health endpoints - Residency policy evaluator: pkg/policy/residency/evaluator.go - RBAC v2 binder: pkg/rbacv2/bindings/sidecar_binding.go - Audit attenuator middleware: pkg/audit/attenuator/middleware.go - Installer hooks and Helm chart fragments for private-installer and redwood-helm-charts to opt into sidecar deployment - Integration tests and unit tests: test/integration/kms_sidecar_residency_test.go, test/unit/audit_attenuator_test.go - Docs: docs/compliance/kms-sidecar.md and runbook: docs/incidents/kms-policy-enforcer.md Rollout: staged canary to Dedicated first (10% traffic), then Private default opt-in for new clusters with an operator feature flag. Backout plan included in runbook. Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] integration test for regional fallback [x] docs and rollout runbook [x] Linear tickets created [x] security review requested Follow-ups: add metrics for rejection-rate and attenuation-rates to Console and hook into Optimize recommendations.
